jobs.description:
You will be a member of our SEM/TEM team. This team is responsible for in-line and out-of-line released electron microscopy inspection.  As a TEM technician you ensure the smooth processing of the various TEM inspections, focusing on the quality of the inspection. 

As SEM/TEM technician you will have the following key responsibilities: 

• You follow-up the inline TEM queue.
• You adjust released recipes for automated TEM inspections.
• You are responsible for (semi)-automated and guided TEM inspections.
• You contribute to achieving targets.
• You help with statistical process control (SPC) on TEM tools. 

• Preferable you have a bachelor’s degree or associate degree (2-year program) in science (chemistry, biology, physics) or equal to experience.
• It would be a great plus if you have hands-on experience with automated metrology or SEM/TEM inspections in the semi-conductor industry.  
• You are a strong planner and you would enjoy working in a fast-paced environment. You certainly know how to multi-task and prioritize assignments.  
• You are a communicative team player with a very good knowledge of both English and Dutch.
• You are prepared to work in a shift system (early/late/night and 1 weekend out of 4).

We guarantee that you won’t be bored
 

As a process operator, you have several responsibilities: 
 
 

• You will receive an intensive training before coordinating and operating high-end devices in the clean room. 

• You organize your own workload according to defined goals. 

• You are responsible for the quality of your own processing. 

• You perform quality tests meticulously. 

• You accurately report problems to our engineers.  

• You have a keen eye for safety and operational efficiency. 

• You suggest improvements.  

Who are we looking for?
 

Well, an enthusiastic personality and a passion for technology already go a long way. You are hands-on, full of expectation and eager to prove yourself. You enjoy working in a team, are accurate, dare to take initiative and are not afraid of asking questions. You have fluent communication skills in English. You are not looking for a typical nine-to-five and you see the advantages of working in shifts every now and again — handsome bonusses and lots of quality time on your hands while others are ‘insanely busy’. An example of our shift regime:
 
 

• Week X: You will work the early shift from Monday to Friday. 

• Week X+1: You work the night shift from Monday to Friday. 

• Week X+2: You work the late shift from Monday to Wednesday, on Thursday and Friday you have recuperation and on Saturday and Sunday you work 12h. 

• Week X+3: From Monday to Wednesday you have recuperation and on Thursday and Friday you work in the late shift. 

• Week X: You work from Monday to Friday in the early shift.

For our partner in the Beveren region, we are looking for a Senior Fullstack .NET Developer with a strong backend focus within .NET. You should also feel comfortable occasionally contributing to frontend development (React or Blazor).

As a Senior Developer, you will be part of a team of 5 developers and work on the transformation of a large and complex legacy application landscape. You will help modernize existing business-critical systems and evolve towards a future-oriented and modern architecture.

Within this environment, you will have the opportunity to take on a key role in the further evolution of the internal application landscape of an international company.

Growth potential: In the longer term, there may be opportunities within the team to grow into a team lead role. This requires both technical maturity and strong people and communication skills.

 
Role responsibilities:
• Develop and maintain backend-driven web and API solutions in .NET (C#, ASP.NET Core)
• Modernize existing applications and contribute to migrations towards modern architectures
• Translate functional requirements into scalable and secure technical solutions
• Develop and integrate REST APIs between different systems
• Collaborate on frontend development using React and/or Blazor
• Ensure code quality through testing, code reviews, and documentation
• Act as a technical point of contact and coach for less experienced colleagues
• Contribute to architecture, technical decisions, and future evolution

Profile

• At least 7 years of experience in a .NET environment
• Strong knowledge of .NET Core, C#, ASP.NET, Entity Framework, and React and/or Blazor
• Experience with REST APIs, application security, and CI/CD processes
• Familiar with Git and containerization such as Docker, OpenShift, or Kubernetes
• Interest/basic knowledge of cloud technologies such as Azure
• Experience with legacy applications (WPF/WinForms)
• Strong analytical mindset, independent, and responsible
• Fluent communication in English; knowledge of Dutch is a nice to have

Comecer is expanding its international Service Team! To strengthen our team in Belgium, we are looking for 
Field Service Engineers, preferably based in the 
Brussels–Leuven region. You will be employed by Orise NV 
(former Process Automation Solutions), based in Belgium, and part of ATS Corporation, while working closely with Comecer Netherlands BV and the wider Comecer team.
 

In this role, you will help install, maintain and support high-tech systems that play a critical role in the (radio)pharmaceutical and nuclear medicine sectors.
 

Comecer’s solutions are developed and manufactured in Joure (The Netherlands) and are used in complex laboratory environments worldwide.
 

 
 

What you will do
 

In this role, you will be 
responsible for installing, servicing, and maintaining Comecer equipment at customer sites throughout Belgium. You will carry out both preventive and corrective maintenance, ensuring that each system performs optimally and meets all operational requirements. In addition, you will provide 
training and technical support to end users, helping them understand and operate the equipment effectively. Throughout every assignment, you will communicate clearly and professionally with customers and internal teams, representing Comecer as a trusted, solution-oriented technical expert.

What you bring
 

You bring hands‑on experience in repairing technical equipment and troubleshooting both mechanical and electrical issues. You are able to read and interpret electrical, pneumatic and mechanical drawings, and you have a background in electronics, electromechanics or mechanical engineering. In this role, strong communication skills and a customer‑focused attitude are essential, along with a willingness to travel within Belgium and occasionally abroad. You have an energetic, proactive and solution‑driven mindset.
 

Requirements:
 
 

• Technical degree at secondary or bachelor level (electromechanics, electronics or mechatronics). 

• Strong English and French skills; Dutch is an advantage. 

• Experience with PLC-controlled systems is considered as a plus. 

• Valid category B driving licence.

As a quality control associate, you will inspect incoming and outgoing goods. You will verify quantities, record data, and follow up on discrepancies in accordance with established procedures. If you identify damage, incorrect products, or incorrect quantities, you will report them and help find a solution. Your meticulous approach ensures that the quality of the goods and the logistics process are maintained.

 

• You work accurately and have an eye for detail

• You can work independently and take initiative when necessary

• You check and record figures quickly and accurately

• You communicate clearly in the event of damage, incorrect products, or discrepancies in quantities

• You can work according to established procedures

• You are available for a permanent late-shift position

• You are comfortable using a tablet

• You have a very good command of English, as communication with the team leader will be in English

jobs.occupation: Customer Support Advisor: English + German + 1 other European Language - Multiple Shifts - Oostakker
jobs.description:
For our client we're looking for a Customer Service Officer.In this role, you become the voice of support for drivers facing unexpected vehicle issues across Europe. You'll be part of a fast-paced and multilingual contact center where your communication skills, empathy, and sense of urgency play a crucial role in keeping transport moving. 

 
• Handle incoming assistance requests from international customers experiencing roadside vehicle breakdowns. 
 
• Take ownership of each case by coordinating with local service providers and technicians until the issue is resolved. 
 
• Maintain constant communication with both the customer and service partner, providing regular updates and reassurance. 
 
• Think on your feet and apply a proactive approach to problem-solving, often finding creative solutions under time pressure. 
 
• Be an integral part of a tight-knit, multilingual team that thrives on collaboration and mutual support. 
 
• Operate within a 24/7 environment, where teamwork and flexibility are essential to ensuring seamless customer experiences. 

- You speak and write fluently in English, German and at least one other European language. 

 
• Service-driven and naturally inclined to go the extra mile to support customers in stressful situations. 
 
• Strong interpersonal skills help you adapt your communication style to various cultural and professional contexts. 
 
• You enjoy working in a diverse team setting and are always ready to help others succeed. 
 
• Flexibility to work in a rotating shift schedule, including nights and weekends. 
 
• A hands-on mentality with a structured and solution-oriented mindset. 
 
• Eagerness to continuously develop your skills and embrace new challenges.

Blue Pimento is looking for a Business Analyst 

 

Blue Pimento is looking for a Business Analyst to support the design and continuous improvement of processes and tools for both individual and professional customers in finance/insurance.

 

Key Responsibilities

• Business Analysis: Gather, analyze, prioritize and document business requirements, translating them into functional specifications, user stories and process flows.

• Process Optimization: Assess existing processes, identify improvement opportunities and contribute to digital transformation initiatives, including partner portals, automation and self-service solutions.

• Solution Design & Implementation: Work closely with business, IT, architecture, operations and compliance teams to design suitable solutions, support user acceptance testing (UAT) and facilitate change management.

• Stakeholder Collaboration: Organize workshops and presentations, engage key stakeholders and ensure that transformation initiatives meet business objectives.

• Agile Delivery: Actively contribute to team activities, backlog management and Agile ceremonies, promoting Agile values and principles.

 

YOUR PROFILE 

·       Proven experience as a Business Analyst (+ 5 years).

·       Bachelor in information technology, software engineering, computer science, or related field

·       Familiarity with Agile methodologies, backlog management tools and team ceremonies.

·       Strong analytical and communication skills, with the ability to understand diverse stakeholder needs while maintaining a global perspective.

·       Ability to engage stakeholders, influence decisions and build commitment.

·       Fluent in English and either French or Dutch.

 

OUR OFFER

In addition to a complete salary package that includes a choice of several benefits that you can pick depending on your personal expectations, we offer the opportunity to join an experienced team of people who share a dedicated interest in Information Technologies.

 

BLUE PIMENTO COMPANY PROFILE

Dynamic Consultancy services firm with a human scale, based in Mont-Saint-Guibert, Belgium, Blue Pimento is dedicated to development and deployment of business-oriented platforms. We help mid-sized companies in maximizing the business value of their information systems changes. 

The success of Blue Pimento is based on Quality & Flexibility of the work performed by its consultants and most of the repeating assignments results from our customer's confidence.

jobs.occupation: Nexin - Medior / Senior BizTalk and .NET Developer
jobs.description:
Our client is a well-established Belgian logistics and distribution company operating nationwide with multiple sites across the country.

The organization manages time-sensitive distribution flows and supplies thousands of retail points daily. As part of its strategic evolution, the company is expanding into new product categories while modernizing its IT landscape.
The environment combines

• A stable SME culture with flat hierarchy

• Long-term employee retention

• High operational criticality

• A strong ongoing digital transformation program

To strengthen the internal IT team, our client is looking for a Medior / Senior BizTalk & .NET Developer (minimum 5 years of experience).
Your role

You will join an experienced internal IT department (infrastructure + development) and actively contribute to the evolution of business-critical applications.

You will:

•  Design, develop and maintain integrations using Microsoft BizTalk Server 2020 and C#/.NET.

• Create and maintain schemas, MAPS, orchestrations, pipelines, ports and adapter configurations.

• Develop .NET components, services and REST/SOAP integrations; work with XML, XSD, XSLT and JSON.

• Write and optimize SQL Server queries and stored procedures, and implement validation, error handling and logging.

• Translate business requirements into technical solutions with business analysts and application owners.

 

Day to day support

• Monitor interfaces and application health; investigate failed exchanges, suspended messages and processing delays.

• Handle daily support requests and production incidents, prioritize business impact and keep users informed.

• Diagnose issues across BizTalk, .NET, SQL Server and connected systems; coordinate resolution with IT teams and external partners.

• Restore processing safely, including controlled message resubmission, and investigate root causes to prevent recurring incidents.

• Maintain support procedures, runbooks and incident records; turn recurring problems into permanent improvements.

 

Quality and delivery

• Test integrations and .NET changes, including failure scenarios, and contribute to code reviews.

• Manage source code in GIT and support deployments with environment-specific configurations and rollback procedures.

• Document interfaces and technical changes, and share knowledge with colleagues.

You will collaborate closely with business stakeholders and operational teams. As a BizTalk and .NET developer, you will work in tandem with another colleague
Work environment

• Multicultural team

• Flat organizational structure

• Short decision-making lines

• Strong collaboration culture

• Fun culture

• On-site presence in Belgium required (with homeworking)

• At least 5 years of professional experience in software development, including proven experience developing and supporting Microsoft BizTalk and C#/.NET solutions, ideally with BizTalk Server 2020.

• Strong C# and .NET Framework skills, with hands-on experience in Visual Studio.

• Practical knowledge of BizTalk messaging, routing, promoted properties, MAPS, orchestrations and pipelines.

• Experience with XML/XSD, XSLT, JSON, REST/SOAP services and adapters such as sFTP and WCF-SQL.

• Solid SQL Server skills and experience troubleshooting integration or application issues in production.

• Experience with GIT, testing and structured deployment practices.

• Ability and willingness to combine development work with daily application support.

• Proven use of AI tools in software development, such as coding assistants for implementation, testing, debugging and documentation, with critical review of generated output and respect for data confidentiality.

• Fluent in Dutch or French, with a good working command of English.

 

Additional assets

• Experience with SAP integrations, EDI/AS2 or other enterprise systems.

• Knowledge of modern .NET, ASP.NET Core, Azure Logic Apps, Service Bus or API Management.

• Experience with CI/CD, PowerShell, monitoring tools, or Jira and Confluence.

• Knowledge of Broadcom Automic for scheduling and monitoring automated jobs and workflows.

 

Soft skills

• An analytical mindset and a methodical approach to troubleshooting.

• Ownership of issues through to resolution, with clear communication and a focus on business needs.

• Ability to manage priorities calmly, collaborate with colleagues and document solutions clearly.
